limitations: All candidate attributes and targets are fictional; official identifiers are used only to exercise level and namespace handling.
Person controls are computed from linked person rows aggregated to household contributions before applying household weights.
A zero target is a declared test constraint, not evidence that the category is structurally impossible in disseminated Census data.
The fixture proves bounded software behavior, not national coverage or Canadian-population quality.

parent_child_reconciliation.limitation: The two real DA identities are an intentionally bounded subset of the CSD. Their fictional targets sum to the fictional CSD targets solely to test reconciliation; they do not exhaust the real Montreal CSD.
